statements: When VGR_1_Pick_Up_And_Transport_Run3 is completed, then HBW_1_Store is happening.
There occurs a failure in SM_2_Transport, if the temperature sensor measures a value above 50 degree.
Upon completion of the event HW_1_Human_Review, either the events Human_Worker_Pressed_Green_Button or Human_Worker_Pressed_Red_Button are executed.
Trace 102 starts with the event HBW_2_Unload as only start event.
The event HBW_1_Get_Empty_Bucket is executed in parallel to VGR_1_Pick_Up_and_Transport_Run2. After both events are completed, the event VGR_1_Pick_Up_And_Transport_Run3 is executed.
SM_2_Transport fails if there is a loud noise above approximately 90 decibels.
If the sensor value capturing the pressure is above something like 0.48 bar, WT_2_Pick_Up_And_Transport operation speed is 1.5 times slower.
The event VGR_1_Pick_Up_And_Transport is executed after the event DM_2_Lower.
Before HBW_1_Store is executed VGR_1_Pick_Up_And_Transport_Run3 is completed.
After VGR_2_Pick_Up_And_Transport and HBW_2_Store_Empty_Bucket are happening simultaneously, OV_2_Burn is executed.
The event Human_Worker_Pressed_Green_Button has a uniform distribution with a  minimum of 2 minutes 3 seconds and maximum of 5 minutes 56 seconds.
After HBW_2_Unload, the events VGR_2_Pick_Up_And_Transport and HBW_2_Store_Empty_Bucket are executed at the same time.
Every 50000 executions of VGR_2_Pick_Up_And_Transport the battery needs to be changed.
The event Restore_SM_2_Transport is normally finished within 12 to 16 minutes in a triangular probability distribution.
After Human_Worker_Pressed_Green_Button or Human_Worker_Pressed_Red_Button, the events HBW_1_Get_Empty_Bucket AND VGR_1_Pick_Up_And_Transport_Run2 are executed in parallel.
If the sensor value for the vibration is equal or higher than 7.1, WT_2_Pick_Up_And_Transport will fail immediately.
The process end is a direct successor of HBW_1_Store.
